title: GET /health (aliases /healthz, /v1/health): the engine's and its status responder's
description: The open answer (a proxied caller without the token) is {status} alone. The full answer (a loopback caller without proxy headers, or the token) adds the configuration; the setup-mode answer says mode setup; the status responder (QSE_STATUS_PORT) answers 503 with its state and the facts under engine. engine_api is MAJOR.MINOR; a missing one means 1.0. Further fields may appear: additionalProperties is true.

status.description: the engine: ok, busy, draining (503) or failed (500, a GPU context that no longer answers); the status responder: the engine's state from the status file

engine_api.description: the engine API version, MAJOR.MINOR (server/engine_api.py VERSION); absent: 1.0

status_port.description: the status responder's port (QSE_STATUS_PORT), null when off

weights.description: the weight profile; name is what TandemNode shows

error.description: status failed: in words; the status responder: the OpenAI error object

engine.description: the status responder: the engine's facts (state, since, reason, expected_s)
